tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether Renzy Plumbers covers a London postcode and list the bookable arrival windows, with their hourly rates in GBP, for the next N days. Use this before book_plumber. Read-only: it does not book a visit, contact the customer, or change anything.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "book_plumber" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
